{{Top|leg}}
'''Braboli''' was a luxurious snack food that was favored by dignitaries of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that followed the end of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Braboli was often served as an accompaniment to various [[Alcohol/Legends|liquors]], including [[Ryborean gax]].<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
